verdict: Purchases up 50% this week, but revenue remains uneven and needs steadying.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered a 4.8x return on $1,483.14 in spend, with the Muslim Subscription Box campaign accounting for the majority of that activity. Purchases jumped 50% week-over-week, which is a genuine positive, but the 28-day return figure is propped up by a single large revenue day in July — the underlying week-to-week trend is softer, and the last three days showed a notable dip in purchases relative to spend. More urgently, your Google Business Profile recorded zero customer actions on August 6th and 7th after averaging 18 per day for the prior 26 days — that's being investigated and addressed now. A live-cooking content shoot is scheduled for August 14th, and a full funnel test with proper tracking goes live by end of August, both of which are expected to stabilise results heading into September.
